items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: But my other son just made an album last week with -- for Capitol, beautiful singer. His name is Paul Tate

ctx.x: Yeah, he had a -- well, he's not retarded. He had like a little nervous breakdown. Fantastic, he's a clarinet player, he would have been fantastic clarinet player. You know, Gary, he goes sometimes like a year and don't pick up his horn and do you know we go through some duets and things and he doesn't get hung up? He just runs through them. And the horn's dry, no chops. Man, there wouldn't have been no end if he hadn't gotten sick. So when he got sick, he wanted -- then he wanted to be a rock and roll singer,…
